profiles.notes: The 2027 booklet lists programme-specific school entry and progression routes for education, environment and sustainability programmes.

requirements.label: Diploma entry · five NSSCO subjects
requirements.details: On the school-leaving route, obtain at least 22 Namibian points across five different NSSCO subjects, including English at E or above.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · pp. 31, 33, 36–37, 40

profiles.notes: The 2027 booklet lists programme-specific school entry and progression routes for education, environment and sustainability programmes.

requirements.label: Mature tourism applicants · relevant industry
requirements.details: The required three years of mature-entry experience must be in tourism, hospitality or events.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 30

requirements.label: Environmental bachelor’s · diploma entry
requirements.details: The prior-award route lists Level 6 diplomas in Sustainable Ocean and Aquaculture Management, Ecotourism and Protected Areas Management, or Water Resources Management. An equivalent Level 6 diploma is also accepted.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 28

requirements.label: Tourism diploma · prerequisite certificate
requirements.details: The prior-study route accepts the Level 5 IUM Certificate in Tourism, Hospitality and Events Management or a Level 5 equivalent from a recognised, accredited institution.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 31

requirements.label: Ecotourism honours · prerequisite diploma
requirements.details: For prior-study entry, hold the Level 6 IUM Diploma in Ecotourism and Protected Areas Management or a Level 6 equivalent from a recognised, accredited institution.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 31

requirements.label: Transport and maritime diplomas · prerequisite certificate
requirements.details: The prior-award route accepts a Level 5 Certificate in Transport and Logistics Management or a Level 5 certificate in a related field.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 33

requirements.label: Occupational safety diploma · certificate alternative
requirements.details: An NQF Level 5 Certificate in Occupational Health and Safety or equivalent is an alternative to the school-leaving points route.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 33

requirements.label: Transport honours · prerequisite diploma
requirements.details: The prior-award route accepts a Level 6 Diploma in Transport and Logistics Management or in a related field.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 33

requirements.label: Occupational safety honours · prerequisite diploma
requirements.details: The prior-award route accepts a Level 6 Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety or in a related field.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 34

requirements.label: Diploma progression · ocean and aquaculture certificate
requirements.details: The prior-award route accepts a Level 5 Certificate in Sustainable Ocean and Aquaculture Management or an equivalent.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · pp. 36, 40

requirements.label: Water diploma · water resources certificate
requirements.details: The water diploma also accepts a Level 5 Certificate in Water Resources Management or equivalent.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 40

requirements.label: Ocean and water honours · eligible diplomas
requirements.details: The prior-award route accepts a Level 6 diploma in Water Resources Management or Sustainable Ocean and Aquaculture Management, or an equivalent Level 6 diploma.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · pp. 36, 40

requirements.label: Energy systems diploma · prerequisite certificate
requirements.details: The prior-award route accepts a Level 5 Certificate in Energy Management or equivalent.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 37

requirements.label: Energy development honours · prerequisite diploma
requirements.details: The prior-award route accepts a Level 6 Diploma in Energy Systems and Climate Change or an equivalent Level 6 diploma.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 38

requirements.label: Environmental doctorate · prior master’s
requirements.details: Applicants need a master’s degree in a relevant discipline registered at NQF Level 9, or an equivalent Level 9 qualification.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · pp. 29–30, 37, 41

requirements.label: Ecotourism master’s · prerequisite honours degree
requirements.details: Hold the Level 8 IUM BSc Honours in Ecotourism and Protected Areas Management or a Level 8 equivalent from a recognised, accredited institution.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 32

requirements.label: Ecotourism doctorate · prerequisite master’s
requirements.details: Hold the Level 9 IUM MSc in Ecotourism and Protected Areas Management or a Level 9 equivalent from a recognised, accredited institution.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 32

requirements.label: Maritime or transport master’s · prerequisite degree
requirements.details: Hold a Bachelor of Transport and Logistics Management Honours at NQF Level 8 or a related equivalent at the same level.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 34

requirements.label: Occupational safety MPhil · prerequisite degree
requirements.details: Hold a Level 8 BSc Honours in Occupational Health and Safety or an equivalent qualification in a related field from a recognised university.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 35

requirements.label: Transport doctorate · prerequisite master’s
requirements.details: Hold a Level 9 master’s in transport and logistics management or a related equivalent.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 35

requirements.label: Master’s entry · Climate Change Mitigation and Adaptation
requirements.details: Hold the NQF Level 8 honours qualification in Climate Change Mitigation and Adaptation or an equivalent Level 8 qualification.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 29

requirements.label: Master’s entry · Environmental Management and Sustainable Development
requirements.details: Hold the NQF Level 8 honours qualification in Environmental Management and Sustainable Development or an equivalent Level 8 qualification.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 29

requirements.label: Master’s entry · Conservation Agriculture Management
requirements.details: Hold the NQF Level 8 honours qualification in Conservation Agriculture Management or an equivalent Level 8 qualification.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 29

requirements.label: Master’s entry · Sustainable Ocean and Aquaculture Management
requirements.details: Hold the NQF Level 8 honours qualification in Sustainable Ocean and Aquaculture Management or an equivalent Level 8 qualification.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 36

requirements.label: Master’s entry · Water Management for Development
requirements.details: Hold the NQF Level 8 honours qualification in Water Management for Development or an equivalent Level 8 qualification.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 41

requirements.label: Energy MBA · honours or postgraduate diploma
requirements.details: Hold a Level 8 honours degree related to oil, gas and energy management, or a Level 8 postgraduate diploma in energy studies or a related field. Either IUM awards or equivalent accredited qualifications from other higher education institutions can qualify.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 39

requirements.label: Energy doctorate · prerequisite master’s
requirements.details: Hold a Level 9 master’s in oil, gas and energy management or a related equivalent.

source.title: IUM · 2027 General Information for Prospective Students · p. 39

requirements.label: Environmental Management and Sustainable Development · distance option
